membersite_banner: Choose Your Side Double The Prize
pf_algorithm: Index Value = ((Random number + X) mod Number of balls left) + 1
pf_client_seed_tooltip:
Client Seed is generated from Player’s side.
Merge Client Seed of all betting players in sequential order from the first player to the last one without any space.
pf_combined_sha512_hash_tooltip: The final result is determined by a combination of the Server Seed and the Client Seed of all betting players, subsequently converted into a SHA512 hash.
pf_settings_para_1: The final result is determined by a combination of the Server Seed and the Client Seed of all betting players.
pf_verification_msg_verify_successful: The final result and SHA512 hash match those provided in the game.
pf_verification_msg_verify_unsuccessful: The final result and SHA512 hash do not match those provided in the game.
pf_verification_para_3: Convert first 2 characters SHA512 to Decimal
